content: Anọng p'Israẹl adimi obhon kw'Ayi

Iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Joshua bi, “Tte ojora oning-ọ osi; tte ẹfa ening-ọ ẹha. Tzima arim-egbong biphyir abina avura atza arima odedenmon kw'Ayi abẹ. Kkeri kaam nkk'ọvaarnọng kw'Ayi, ọmaana anọng pẹ, ọmaana odedenmon kwẹ, ttara ẹkhọma chẹ ndọkha ngọ-ọ ka mbọhk.

Kọ akhaambi ási ọbhon kw'Ayi ọmaana ọvaarnọng kwẹ, odem kw'iwa asi obhon kwa Jeriko ọmaana ọvaarnọng kwẹ. Bọng áchi ọgbọm f'ekpo, bọng ábira átzọkha etzirakpo akhaama. Bọng áchubha ka mpa-nnam s'odedenmon atzik.”
Mando kwa Joshua ọmaana arim-egbong biphyir afon atza arima Ayi abẹ. Wa otzekha arim-egbong pẹ akkakka p'apyiri nnọhna arọbh attaan obhiri chi, ọtzọhm bẹ k'erungi
ttara ẹtzọhngdọra bi: “Bọng dọkha ogbe ayonga itzọhng e. Bọng akhaambi achubha ka mpa-nnam s'odeenmon atzik. Bọng k'ibe s'ibhiri eden kàtza o. Bọng biphyir bọng for sabọng kàraama.
Kaam ọmaana anọng biphyir p'awobh ttar-m, móchina ororo ọnwa k'odedenmon nwa. Mada ajinọng mba ayin k'iyaan bi, akwu arima man abẹ, mach'iwa bẹ achi eden asi, maman ọ́rọbh-ọrọbh oji bẹ.
Bẹ akhubh man maa, more bi mokk'bẹ ọbọhra bẹ abina aji odedenmon, da bẹ aben bi, ‘Bẹ atzima arọbhi man ọrọbh, mach'iwa bẹ achi eden arọbh man e.’ Mada mọrọbh oji bẹ,
bọng abina kẹ da bọng achubha atzik, atza achi odedenmon nwa. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng ọttẹ-ẹ ọbọhk otte ọnang bọng.
Idikha bọng akk'odedenmon nwa acha, bọng gẹ-ẹ ekpon. Bọng si atzor k'odem kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'bọng ọgbaakha. Bọng nne kwẹ bi, kaam nkk'bọng ẹfa nnanga.”
Mẹ wọ ofon, Joshua ọtzọhm bẹ afona. Wa bẹ afona atza achubha k'ibe s'iwobh k'ottem kwa Bẹtẹl ọmaana Ayi, k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi k'Ayi. Yina, wa Joshua oyima ọmaana anọng mba m'erungiwu nduma.
K'ekpekpebha ch'ewu ehobh mẹ, Joshua otzobha arim-egbong pẹ, kẹ ọmaana adedennọng p'Israẹl arenga anọng mba k'itzitzikha, atzima bẹ afona achina k'Ayi.

Mando kw'arim-egbong mba biphyir p'awobh ttar-ẹ atzọn-ẹ abẹ avura k'odedenmon nwa, atza abe k'itzitzikha s'obhon. Be attima ibhingabe k'ebir-ebira kw'Ayi, bẹ akhe ittolim k'ottem kwa bẹ ọmaana odedenmon
Ode ch'iwa Joshua okk'ajinọng nnọhna jobh obhiri mfa obhiri arọbh jobh, ọtzọkha ohok bẹ ochubha k'ottem kwa Bẹtẹl ọmaana Ayi maa, apyiri k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi k'odedenmon.

Mando kw'arim-egbong mba atzọk ewobha k'obe fabẹ. Ayok p'awobh k'ibhingabe awobha k'ebir-ebira kw'odedenmon, ayok p'achubbh-ochubha awobha k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi k'odedenmon. M'erungiwu nduma, Joshua ofona ọhakha k'ittolim.

Mada ọvaarnọng kw'Ayi ore odik nwa, kẹ ọmaana ajinọng p'odedenmon biphyir adukha ayin k'iyaan k'ekpekpebha, atza arima anọng p'Israẹl abẹ k'ibe rani s'irọni Araba. Yina, wa kẹ korong bi, anọng akk'achubha ka mpa-nnnam s'odedenmon atzikh-ẹ.
Wa Joshua ọmaana anọng p'Israẹl biphyir atte for sabẹ ọbọhk bi, ayok akhubh bẹ akpa nnam, bẹ arọbh achina k'okhubha kw'ibe s'anọng an-arukhi.
Wa bẹ abeni ajinọng p'Ayi biphyir bi, bẹ akhubh bẹ. Bẹ akhubh Joshua k'ibe s'ibhir-obhir maa, bẹ arọbh aji odedenmon.
Wa ojinọng manda wani kw'orikhi k'Ayi obiro ode Bẹtẹl kode, kw'oni anọng p'Israẹl okhubhi. Wa anọng mba atte odedenmon eje, bẹ akhubh anọng p'Israẹl.

Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Joshua bi, “Nemi ọkhọhn nwuma kw'owobh-ọ m'ọbọhk atzena k'okhubha kw'Ayi, kkeri kọ wọ kwa kaam ńtte odedenmon nwa ọbọhk nnang e.” Mando kwa Joshua onemi ọkhọhn kwẹ otzena ka Ayi.
Otzena ọkhọhn nwa bi kpaar, ajinọng mba p'ira achubh-ochubha abina m'ẹbhar-k'ẹbhar k'obe f'ira bẹ achubh, arọbh akwu. Bẹ adim k'odedenmon, abọkh-ẹ abira akhẹ-ẹ ekpon m'ẹbhar-k'ẹbhar.

Mada ajinọng p'Ayi abhakhi nnam akkeri, bẹ an-are irorong k'iwokhi s'im-iyin k'odedenmon. Yina, bẹ ọphaangi manda wani kwa bẹ areng arọbh kare; wa anọng p'Israẹl pa bẹ akk'akhubha achina k'okhubha kw'ibe s'anọng an-arukhi, an-abhakhi akhubh anọng mba.
Mada Joshua ọmaana anọng p'Israẹl biphyir are bi, ajinọng mba p'ira achubh-ochubha akk'odedenmon abọkha, bẹ abira are irorong s'im-iyin k'odedenmon, bẹ abhakhi arima ajinọng p'Ayi abẹ.

Ajinọng mba p'ira achubh-ochubha abira ayin k'odedenmon akhubh bẹ maa, bẹ an-akhe bẹ k'ottem, da anọng p'Israẹl awobh bẹ k'itzitzikha ọmaana ka nnam. Mando kw'anọng p'Israẹl afhu bẹ maa, bẹ ọnọng manda wani karikhi kw'orukhi akpen, ọnọng kw'obiro ọrọbh ọnaanga kode.
Yina, wa bẹ atzima ọvaarnọng kw'Ayi ekhekhebhi achena Joshua.

K'ogbe kw'anọng p'Israẹl akk'ajinọng p'Ayi afha okpo k'iwoni, ọmaana k'ibe s'anọng an-arukhi, kẹ da ira bẹ akk'bẹ akhubha. K'ogbe kwa bẹ akk'ọkkangkkaang atzima afhu ọnọng kpenamkpen, anọng p'Israẹl biphyir akpa nnam k'Ayi, atza afhu anọng p'awobh kẹ.
Anọng p'Ayi biphyir p'iwa ape m'ewu nduma, ajinọng ọmaana panọng ade: nnọhna ẹrọbh obhiri jobh.
Da iwa Joshua oni ọbọhk kw'otzim ọkhọhn ọtzọri maa, odimi anọng p'arukhi k'Ayi emeni biphyir.
Yina, anọng p'Israẹl atzọkha etzirakpo py'anọng mba akhaama, bẹ abira achi ọgbọm k'odedenmon nwa atzima afona, atzor k'odem kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'Joshua ọtzọhna.
Mando kwa Joshua okhe obhon kwa Ayi ekpon, ọsẹ-ẹ on-ode ahọhm-gbigbini maa, apyiri mayina.

Ọtzọkha ọvaarnọng kwa Ayi ọgbana edik k'echi, ọtte ọbọhk mẹ maa, opyiri k'ẹchọhkha. Ma nchọhkha-bọhk, Joshua ọnang anọng mba ẹfa bi, bẹ ahanga obukhi kwẹ k'echi atza abhari k'ẹbaakhamma ch'odedenmon. Bẹ atzọkha ọtza-khung abubhẹ-ẹ, kw'otzima owobh kẹ maa, apyiri mayina.
Joshua odo echekhi ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi
Iwa Joshua osi ijafọhnibe k'egbegbeho ch'Ebal ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Israẹl,

macha Mosẹs kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, ọkk'anọng p'Israẹl ọtzọhna. Osi ijafọhnibe nna otzor macha bẹ akkẹri ka Nnwẹr kw'Aphaangi pa Mosẹs. Wa bẹ atzim atza pa bẹ an-ọphaphaakhi-aphaakhi atzima asi ijafọhnibe nna, bẹ ọtzọhmttọhk f'okkonga kabira atzima asi sẹ. M'ijafọhnibẹ nna rọ s'iwa bẹ asi nnanga nkwọhmisẹ, ọmaana nnanga s'odidiri anang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
M'itzitzikha s'anọng p'Israẹl, Joshua ọtzọkha aphaangi pa Mosẹs ọkk'ọkkẹra, ọkkẹr k'atza mba.

Wa anọng p'Israẹl biphyir, ọmaana adedennọng pabẹ, ọmaana akhaan-nọng ttara asi-aponga abe k'odimbọhk ttara kw'abọhk kw'Ẹkkọhbhi ch'Echekhi ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, am-akkeri afọhnẹja itzitzikha, p'iwa ade ẹnọmma cha Lẹvi p'atzini ẹkkọhbhi nda. Iwa akhekhennọng p'arukhi ọmaana ammaana awobh mẹ. Ibhaakha rani s'anọng abe akkeri itzitzikha k'egbegbeho cha Gerizim. Ibhaakha nnonggo ibe ikkeri itzitzikha k'egbegbho ch'Ebal, mach'iwa Mosẹs kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọgbaakha, k'ogbe kw'iwa ọnangi ndọhna s'otzim odo anọng p'Israẹl.
Ayongi mẹ, wa Joshua oyeri atzim p'aphaangi biphyir ọnang bẹ, aphaangi p'ẹdaa ọmaana ẹmma ọnanang, atzor k'odem kwa bẹ akkẹri ka Nnwẹr kw'Aphaangi.
Atzim manda bani kade p'iwa Mosẹs ọkk'ọkkẹra, pa Joshua on-oyeri ọnang ebhonmor ch'Israẹl biphyir, attar panọng ọmaana va ttara akhekhennọng p'iwa arukhi k'ottem kwabẹ.
